settings.title: Why SUMIX Started
settings.text: When we became parents, we struggled to find high-quality, organic cotton clothing that was both affordable and stylish. So we decided to create it ourselves right here in Kerala.

settings.title: Our Organic Cotton Promise
settings.text: Every single piece of SUMIX babywear is crafted from 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton. This means no pesticides, no toxic chemicals, and a much softer touch for your baby's delicate skin.
